meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 把你在自己改过的 NanoClaw 副本里做的修改整理成迁移指南，然后在官方最新版本上按这份指南重新改回去，从而不用处理合并冲突就能升级到新版。
howto.when: 当你想把做过自定义的 NanoClaw 副本升级到官方上游并保留自己的改动时，或已有迁移指南、想直接升级时，它会启动对应的提取或升级流程。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 副本升级到上游，保留我的自定义。
say.note: 它会先分析改动生成迁移指南，再在干净版本上重放。

say.text: 先提取我的定制，生成迁移指南，先别升级。
say.note: 只做提取：生成可重放的 guide.md。

say.text: 迁移指南已有，直接执行升级步骤。
say.note: 跳过提取，按已有指南重新应用。

howto.what_en: Extracts the user's customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a migration guide, then upgrades to the upstream version by reapplying those customizations on a clean base, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to upstream while keeping their changes, or wants to skip directly to the upgrade step because a migration guide already exists.

say_en.text: Upgrade my NanoClaw fork to upstream while keeping my customizations.
say_en.note: Extracts changes, writes guide, then reapplies them.

say_en.text: Extract my customizations and write a migration guide only; don't upgrade yet.
say_en.note: Performs the extraction phase and produces a replayable guide.

say_en.text: A migration guide already exists — jump straight to the upgrade step.
say_en.note: Skips extraction; reapplies from existing guide.
